invariants.name: A pass has each skill, the total and each named line at or under its cap
A fail names a skill, the total or a file over its cap
The lower step never raises a word cap or a line cap

carrier.contract: The gate maps the word counts of the skill trees, the longest line of each named file and one budget to one report. A count over its cap is a problem that names the skill or the file, and a count under its cap is a note.

category.equality: Two reports are equal when their problem lists and their note lists are equal in order. Two budgets are equal when their total caps, their skill caps and their line caps are equal.

abstraction.hides: The walk of each skill tree, the word split of each Markdown file, the line split of each named file and the format of the cap file.
callersKnow: A skill or the total over its cap fails the gate, and the failure names it.
A line of a named file over its cap fails the gate, and the failure names the file.
A cap above its count passes with a note, and the lower step sets it to the count.
A cap rises only in a PR that moves text into that skill while the total falls by more, and review enforces that rule.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without lineCounts and the line cap, an AGENTS.md bullet grows one lesson at a time, as line 18 grew to 9,099 characters. Deleting budgetReport puts the cap comparison in main and in each test.

alternatives.name: A line check in scripts/validate.ts
alternatives.rejectedBecause: validate has no lower step, so the cap cannot fall with the count.

alternatives.name: Remove the README counts
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It removes facts that a reader wants.

alternatives.name: Two full copies of the fork rules in the mode
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Each copy costs words, and a test pins each copy.

omitted: The notes of the report, the cap of a gone skill and the line split have no model state. The unit tests examine them.
The model takes each word count and each line count as a true observation.
The docs-versus-tree test, the gh read, the fork link and the text cuts change no guard verdict. Their controls, validate and review examine them.

bounds: Two skills, counts from 0 to 2, a start cap of 1 for each skill and a start total cap of 2.
Each order of the edit, check and lower steps.

negative.defect: A gate that reads only the total passes a skill over its cap while the total stays under its cap.

limits: The finite model takes the word counts and the line counts as true observations, and it covers two counted items only.
The model does not show that the TypeScript code refines it. The linked controls and review examine that relation.
No cap rose in this change, and the total cap fell from 133,781 to 128,940 words.
The model does not check the words of the cut texts, the moved sentences, the runbooks or the ADR notes. Review, validate and the STE gates examine them.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
